paper_title: Prometheus 2 An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating   Other Language Models
caption: When merging models, the influence of relative evaluation on absolute evaluation is greater than the influence of absolute evaluation on relative evaluation. Performance of Direct Assessment (colored in green) and Pairwise Ranking (colored in blue) when altering the value to merge evaluator LMs trained on different formats.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between direct assessment correlation and pairwise ranking accuracy as the ratio of direct assessment to pairwise ranking merging changes. The x-axis is labeled "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio" and represents a linear scale ranging from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick labels at each integer ratio interval. The y-axis is labeled "Pearson Correlation Agreement Accuracy" and utilizes a linear scale ranging from approximately 50 to 80. A black solid line, representing average performance, begins at approximately 0.578 at 1:9 and decreases to approximately 0.543 at 9:1, reaching a minimum of 0.541 at 7:3. A blue dashed line, representing pairwise ranking accuracy, starts at approximately 0.585 at 1:9, rises to a maximum of 0.675 at 4:6, and then decreases to approximately 0.624 at 9:1. A green solid line, representing direct assessment correlation, starts at approximately 0.580 at 1:9, decreases to a minimum of 0.560 at 3:7, then increases to approximately 0.686 at 4:6, afterwards decreasing to approximately 0.620 at 9:1.
